voice.name: Open Sector - AT Infantry
voice.description: Stocky male anti-tank rifleman in his forties, deep rough baritone with a heavy Eastern European accent, blunt and stubborn, deadpan humor, speaks in short heavy sentences like dropping shells, unimpressed by tanks, a veteran who has seen too much and grumbles about his heavy rifle.
voice.sample: Anti-tank. Yes, the rifle is heavy, I know, I carry it. Show me the tank. Side or back, does not matter. One shot, track is gone. Two shots, crew is gone. Tanks are only big tins.

fire.prompt: WWII 14.5mm anti-tank rifle firing a single shot, enormous booming crack louder than a rifle, deep concussive blast with muzzle brake bark and long echo, outdoors, close range, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Soldier jogging on dirt carrying a very long heavy rifle, heavy boots, gear and metal clinking, short burst of footsteps, close, no music, no voice

reload.prompt: Heavy single-shot anti-tank rifle reload, large bolt thrown open, huge brass cartridge ejected clanging on ground, new round shoved in, bolt slammed shut, close up, no music, no voice
